iti73:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One, said by the Arahant, so I have heard:
iti73:2.1: “Monks, formless phenomena are more peaceful than forms; cessation, more peaceful than formless phenomena.”
iti73:3.2: and those standing in the formless,
iti73:4.2: not taking a stance in formless things,
iti73:4.4: are people who’ve left death behind.
iti73:5.1:
Having touched with his body
the deathless property free
iti73:5.5:
the Rightly Self-awakened One
teaches the state
